semantics: Original English 411/B: 1<=n,m,k<=100; exactly n rows of m commands in 0..k. Zero is idle. Only live cores participate in each simultaneous cycle; collisions permanently lock their cell and all writers, and later writes to locked cells lock the core. Output is uniquely n first-lock times, one per line, or 0 for survivors. O(m*(n+k)) counts plus persistent cell locks are cross-checked by frozen-active-set pairwise simulation.
